purpose: Reconstruct the bounded CODECHECK reviewer environment from a public release bundle, execute it with network and privilege controls, and emit an operator-controlled machine receipt.
claim_boundary: A passing container-rebuild receipt proves only that an operator rebuilt the digest-pinned public recipe and reproduced the bounded capsule under the named isolation controls. It is not independent execution, a CODECHECK certificate, scientific validation, field validation, performance endorsement, agency acceptance, or valuation evidence.
human_unlock_policy: Publishing a release, opening a CODECHECK request, transferring a packet, contacting a validator, certifying an assertion, or changing an external-validation field requires duplicate-action reconciliation and fresh action-time HumanUnlock.
